custom_pid_edit.description:
**{action}: {pid_name}**

Enter a formula shorthand (e.g. `B(4)/2.55`) OR fill in the structured fields below. The shorthand parses to the structured fields on save.

**Shorthand notation:**
• `B(n)` — unsigned byte at index n
• `B(n, m)` — big-endian unsigned word, bytes n..m
• `S(n)` / `S(n, m)` — signed equivalents
• `BIT(b, n)` — single bit n of byte b
• Optional `/const` or `*const` suffix

**Structured fields** (for advanced cases: enumerations, sub-byte fields, byte-swap):
• bix — bit offset from start of data
• len — bit length (1-64)
• mul/div/add — linear scaling
• sign — two's complement
• blsb — byte-swap (Intel byte order)
• min/max — clamping
• map_text — enumeration (one `key=value` per line)
custom_pid_edit.title: Add / Edit Custom PID
